verses.en: Tā sīn mīm.
These are the verses of the manifest Book.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: (O Prophet,) perhaps you are going to let yourself collapse in grief because they do not believe.

verses.ar: اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتۡ اَعۡنَاقُهُمۡ لَهَا خٰضِعِيۡنَ
verses.en: If We so will, We can send down to them a sign from the sky, for which their necks will stay bent in submission.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
verses.en: Never a new message comes to them from the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah), but they become averse to it.

verses.ar: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡا فَسَيَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ اَنۭۡ بٰٓؤُا مَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: Thus they rejected (the Truth); well, soon will come to them the real descriptions of what they used to ridicule.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ كَمۡ اَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Have they not looked at the earth, how many of the noble pairs (of vegetation) We have caused to grow in it?

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ نَادٰي رَبُّكَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ ائۡتِ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Remember) when your Lord called Mūsā saying, “Go to the transgressing people,
the people of Pharaoh. Do they not fear Allah?”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “My Lord, I fear that they will reject me.

verses.ar: وَيَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرِيۡ وَلَا يَنۡطَلِقُ لِسَانِيۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ اِلٰي هٰرُوۡنَ
verses.en: My heart gets straitened, and my tongue is not fluent; so send for Hārūn.

verses.ar: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۭۡ بٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِۚۖ‏
verses.en: Moreover, they have (leveled) a charge of offence against me, and I fear they will kill me;”

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ فَاذۡهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ مُّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “Never! (They will not be able to kill you.) So go, both of you, with Our signs. We are with you, listening (to the conversation you will have with him.)

verses.ar: فَاۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, ‘We both are messengers of the Lord of all the worlds,
(sent with the message) that you must send the children of Isrā’īl with us’”.

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِيۡنَا وَلِيۡدًا وَّلَبِثۡتَ فِيۡنَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “Did we not nourish you among us as a child? And you remained amidst us for years,

verses.ar: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ فَعَلۡتَ وَاَنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: and you did the blunder you did; still you are ungrateful.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَا٘ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: He said, “I did that at a time when I was mistaken.

verses.ar: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنۡكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِيۡ رَبِّيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then I fled away from you when I feared you. Thereafter my Lord granted wisdom to me, and made me one of the messengers.

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنۡ عَبَّدۡتَّ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: As for the favor with which you are obliging me, it is that you have enslaved the children of Isrā’īl.”
Pharaoh said, “What is the Lord of the worlds?”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever there is between them, if you are to believe”
He (The Pharaoh) said to those around him, “Are you not hearing?”
He (Mūsā) said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your early forefathers”

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوۡلَكُمُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “Your messenger who is sent to you is a mad man indeed.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the East and the West and whatever lies between them, if you are to understand.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذۡتَ اِلٰهًا غَيۡرِيۡ لَاَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمَسۡجُوۡنِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “If you adopt a God other than me, I will certainly put you to prison.”
He (Mūsā) said “Will you (do this) even if I bring to you something evident?”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاۡتِ بِهٖ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Then bring it, if you are truthful.”

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚۖ‏
verses.en: So, he threw down his staff, and in no time it was a serpent, clearly visible,

verses.ar: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: and he drew out his hand, and right then it was a white light to the onlookers.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَاِ حَوۡلَهٗ٘ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said to the chiefs around him “This man is certainly an expert sorcerer”.

verses.ar: يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهٖࣗۖ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He wants to expel you from your land with his sorcery. So what do you suggest?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَرۡجِهۡ وَاَخَاهُ وَابۡعَثۡ فِي الۡمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “Leave him and his brother alone for some time, and send heralds to the cities,
so that they bring to you every highly expert sorcerer.”
So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a known day,
and it was said to the people, “Would you assemble,

verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: so that we may follow the sorcerers if they are victorious?”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوۡا لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ كُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a sure reward for us, if we are the victorious?”

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Yes, and of course, you will then be among the closer ones.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰ٘ي اَلۡقُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Mūsā said to them, “Throw you down what you are to throw.”

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقَوۡا حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُوۡا بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: So they threw down their ropes and their staffs and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the triumphant for sure.”

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي مُوۡسٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَاۡفِكُوۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: Then Mūsā threw down his staff, and in no time it started swallowing the falsehood they invented.
So the sorcerers were made (by the truth they saw) to fall down in prostration.
They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
the Lord of Mūsā and Hārūn.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. Surely, he (Mūsā) is the chief of you all, who has taught you sorcery. So you will soon know (your fate). I will cut off your hands and feet from different sides, and will crucify you all together.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا ضَيۡرَؗ اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: They said, “There is no harm. We will return to our Lord.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَا٘ اَنۡ كُنَّا٘ اَوَّلَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
verses.en: We really hope that our Lord will forgive us our faults, as we are the first of the believers.”

verses.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ٘ اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Make My servants travel at night. You will be pursued.”
So Pharaoh sent into the cities (his) men to muster (people)
saying, “These are a small band,
and indeed they are enraging us,
and we are a host, well-armed.”
Thus We expelled them (i.e. the people of Pharaoh) from gardens and springs,
and from treasures and a noble abode.
Thus it was. And We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit all such things.
So they (the people of Pharaoh) pursued them (the people of Mūsā) at the time of sunrise.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الۡجَمۡعٰنِ قَالَ اَصۡحٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mūsā said, “Surely we are overtaken.”

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ اِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّيۡ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
verses.en: He said, “Never! Indeed with me is my Lord. He will guide me.”

verses.ar: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡبَحۡرَؕ فَانۡفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٍ كَالطَّوۡدِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
verses.en: So We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Strike the sea with your staff.” So it was severed apart, and each part became like a big mountain.
Then We brought others close to that place.
And We saved Mūsā and all those with him.
Then we drowned the others.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And recite before them the narrative of Ibrāhīm,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
verses.en: when he said to his father and to his people, “What do you worship?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا نَعۡبُدُ اَصۡنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We worship idols, and stay devoted to them.”
He said, “Do they listen to you when you call (them)
or do they bring benefit to you or harm?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “No, but we have found our fathers doing like this.”
He said, “Have you then ever considered what you have been worshipping,
you and your ancient fathers,

verses.ar: فَاِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ٘ اِلَّا رَبَّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: they all are an enemy to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
who created me, and who guides me,
and Who feeds me and gives me drink,
and when I become sick, He heals me,
and who will make me die, then will give me life,

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ٘ اَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لِيۡ خَطِيۡٓـَٔتِيۡ يَوۡمَ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: and who, I hope, will forgive my fault on the Day of Retribution.

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِيۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: O my Lord, give me wisdom, and make me join the righteous,

verses.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِي الۡاٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: and destine for me a truthful description among the next generations,
and make me among those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

verses.ar: وَاغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِيۡ٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: and forgive my father. Indeed he was one of those who went astray,
and do not put me to disgrace on the Day when all will be raised to life,

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: the Day when neither wealth will be of any use (to any one) nor sons,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَي اللّٰهَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِيۡمٍؕ‏
verses.en: except to him who will come to Allah with a sound heart,
and the Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing
and the Hell will be fully uncovered for the perverse,
and it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you used to worship

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: beside Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?’
So they (their false gods) will be thrown on their faces into it - they and the erring people
and the entire army of Iblīs (Satan), all together.
They will say when they will be quarreling there with each other,

verses.ar: تَاللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنَّا لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: ‘By Allah, we were in open error
when we used to equate you with the Lord of the worlds,
and it is only the sinners who misguided us.
Now we have neither any intercessors
nor any true friend.

verses.ar: فَلَوۡ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Would that we have a chance to return whereby we may join the believers!’”

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The people of NūH rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ نُوۡحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: when their brother NūH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
I am an honest messenger for you.
So, fear Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds;
so, fear Allah and obey me.”
They said, “Shall we believe in you while you are followed by the lowest people?”

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِيۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: He said, “I do not know about what they do;

verses.ar: اِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّيۡ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: their account is with none but with my Lord, if you have sense.
And I am not the one who would drive the believers away;
I am no more than a plain warner.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰنُوۡحُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَرۡجُوۡمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: They said, “Should you not stop, O NūH, you will surely be stoned.”
He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

verses.ar: فَافۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحًا وَّنَجِّنِيۡ وَمَنۡ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: So judge between me and them with an open verdict, and save me and all the believers who are with me.”

verses.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۚ‏
verses.en: So We saved him and those with him in the Ark that was fully occupied.
Then We drowned, after that, all the remaining.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Very-Merciful.
The (people of) ‘Ād rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ هُوۡدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
I am an honest messenger for you,
so fear Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
Do you erect on every height a monument, having no sound purpose,
and take the objects of architecture as if you are going to live forever,
and when you seize (someone) you seize as tyrants?
So fear Allah and obey me.
And fear the One who has supported you with what you know.
He has supported you with cattle and sons,
and with gardens and springs.

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍؕ‏
verses.en: In fact I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوَعَظۡتَ اَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡوٰعِظِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “It is all equal for us, whether you give us advice or you do not become one of the advisors.
This is nothing but the practice of the ancient,
and we are not going to be punished.”

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The (people of) Thamūd rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: when their brother SāliH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
I am an honest messenger for you.
So, fear Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
Will you be left secure in whatever is here,
in gardens and springs,
and in farms and date-palms, the spathes of which are interwoven?
You hew out houses from the hills with pride.
So fear Allah and obey me,
and do not obey the order of the transgressors

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: who make mischief on the land and who do not set things right”.
They said, “You are merely one of those bewitched.

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاۚۖ فَاۡتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: You are nothing but a human like us. So, bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرۡبٌ وَّلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍۚ‏
verses.en: He said, “This is a she-camel. She has a share of water, and you have a share of water on a specified day.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: So do not touch her with evil (intent), lest you should be seized by a painful punishment.”
But they killed her, then they became remorseful,

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: and the punishment seized them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The people of LūT rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ لُوۡطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: when their brother LūT said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
I am an honest messenger for you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
Do you go to the males (for having sex) out of the whole universe,

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُوۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عٰدُوۡنَ
verses.en: and leave your wives whom your Lord has created for you? Indeed you are a people who cross (all) limits.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰلُوۡطُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “If you do not stop O LūT, you shall be included among the outcast.”
He said “Indeed, I am annoyed with your act.
My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”
So We saved him and his family, all of them
except an old woman among those who remained behind.
Then We destroyed the others,

verses.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: and subjected them to a terrible rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The people of Aaikah rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: when Shu‘aib said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
I am an honest messenger for you.
So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And I do not claim from you any reward for it; my reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.ar: اَوۡفُوا الۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُخۡسِرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Give full measure, and do not be among those who bring loss to others.
Weigh with an even balance,

verses.ar: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: and do not make people short of their things, and do not spread disorder in the land as mischief-makers,
and be fearful of the One who created you and the former generations.”
They said, “You are but one of the bewitched men.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا وَاِنۡ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: You are no more than a human like us, and in fact we consider you to be one of the liars.

verses.ar: فَاَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: So cause a piece from the sky to fall down upon us, if you are one of the truthful.”
He said, “My Lord knows well what you do.”

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ الظُّلَّةِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the torment of the Day of Canopy. Indeed it was the punishment of a terrible day.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
This (Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
The Trusted Spirit has brought it down
upon your heart, so that you become one of the warners
in plain Arabic language.
And of course, it is (mentioned) in the Scriptures of the former people.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ اٰيَةً اَنۡ يَّعۡلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: Is it not a proof for them that the knowledgeable of the children of Isrā’īl recognize him (the prophet)?
Even if We had revealed it to a Non-Arab,

verses.ar: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
This is how We have made it pass through the hearts of the sinners.

verses.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَۙ‏
verses.en: They will not believe in it until they will see the painful punishment
and it will come to them suddenly while they will not be anticipating (it),
and (then) they will say, “Is it (possible) that we are given some respite?”
Is it then Our punishment that they are trying to hasten up?
So tell me, if We give them enjoyment for years,
then comes to them what they are warned of,

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يُمَتَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: what help can they receive from the comforts they were given to enjoy?

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنۡذِرُوۡنَࣗۖۛ‏
verses.en: We did not destroy any town unless it has had warners
to give advice, and We have never been unjust.
And this (Qur’ān) is not brought down by devils.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: It neither suits them, nor are they able to (do this).
In fact, they are kept far away from hearing (it at the time of revelation).

verses.ar: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُعَذَّبِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: So do not invoke any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among those who are to be punished.
And warn the nearest people of your clan,

verses.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: and be kind with humbleness to the believers who followed you.

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ اِنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: So if they disobey you, then say, “I disown what you do,”
and place your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
Who sees you when you stand (in prayer,)
and (sees) your movement among those who prostrate themselves.
Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: هَلۡ اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيۡنُؕ‏
verses.en: Shall I tell you on whom the devils descend?
They descend on every sinful liar.
They give ear to hear (secretly,) and most of them tell lies.
As for the poets, they are followed by the straying people.

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيۡمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Did you not see that they wander in every valley,
and that they say what they do not?

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا وَّانۡتَصَرُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡاؕ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَيَّ مُنۡقَلَبٍ يَّنۡقَلِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah very much, and defend themselves after they are wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know to which place they are going to return.
